reddit.title: Improved Music Experience in Provincia: Soft Music Reloops
reddit.body: We’ve made significant improvements to the way music transitions play in Provincia. No more jarring cuts when switching between day, night, title, and combat beds! With a new long equal-power self-crossfade, the AI join is now seamless. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
